function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Here’s an overview of some of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers worldwide, along with a brief description of their key products and contributions:

| Company | Headquarters | Notable Vaccines | Key Highlights |
|---------|--------------|------------------|----------------|
| **Pfizer** (USA) | New York City, NY | BNT162b2 (Comirnaty – COVID‑19 mRNA vaccine) | First mRNA vaccine approved for emergency use; also produces vaccines for influenza, HPV, and other diseases. |
| **Moderna** (USA) | Cambridge, MA | mRNA‑1273 (Spikevax – COVID‑19 mRNA vaccine) | Pioneered mRNA technology for rapid vaccine development; also working on RSV and influenza mRNA vaccines. |
| **Johnson & Johnson** (USA) | New Brunswick, NJ | Ad26.COV2.S (Janssen – single‑dose COVID‑19 adenovirus vector vaccine) | Known for its broad portfolio including vaccines for hepatitis A/B, rabies, meningitis, and more. |
| **AstraZeneca** (UK/Sweden) | Cambridge, UK | ChAdOx1 nCoV‑19 (AZD1222 – COVID‑19 adenovirus vector vaccine) | Collaborated with Oxford University; also develops vaccines for malaria, dengue, and other infectious diseases. |
| **Novavax** (USA) | Gaithersburg, MD | NVX-CoV2373 (COVID‑19 protein subunit vaccine) | Uses recombinant nanoparticle technology; also developing vaccines for influenza and RSV. |
| **Sinovac Biotech** (China) | Beijing | CoronaVac (inactivated virus COVID‑19 vaccine) | One of the largest producers of inactivated virus vaccines; also works on influenza and other vaccines. |
| **Sinopharm** (China) | Beijing | BBIBP-CorV (inactivated virus COVID‑19 vaccine) | Developed in partnership with WHO; also produces vaccines for polio, measles, and other diseases. |
| **Bharat Biotech** (India) | Hyderabad | Covaxin (inactivated virus COVID‑19 vaccine) | Developed in collaboration with Indian Council of Medical Research; also produces vaccines for typhoid, hepatitis B, and more. |
| **CureVac** (Germany) | Tübingen | CVnCoV (experimental COVID‑19 mRNA vaccine) | Focuses on non‑modified mRNA platform; also developing vaccines for influenza and other pathogens. |
| **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** (UK) | Brentford, London | Shingrix (recombinant zoster vaccine), Fluzone (influenza vaccine) | Broad portfolio covering vaccines for shingles, influenza, HPV, and more. |
| **Sanofi Pasteur** (France) | Lyon | Prevnar 13 (pneumococcal conjugate vaccine), Fluzone Quadrivalent (influenza vaccine) | Global leader in vaccine manufacturing; also develops vaccines for rabies, Japanese encephalitis, and others. |
| **Merck & Co., Inc.** (USA) | Kenilworth, NJ | Gardasil 9 (HPV vaccine), RotaTeq (rotavirus vaccine) | Strong presence in oncology and vaccines; also developing new vaccines for emerging infections. |
| **BioNTech** (Germany) | Mainz | BNT162b2 (COVID‑19 mRNA vaccine) | Partnered with Pfizer for the first mRNA COVID‑19 vaccine; also exploring cancer immunotherapies. |
| **Takeda Pharmaceutical** (Japan) | Tokyo | Rotarix (rotavirus vaccine), Shingrix (shingles vaccine) | Expanding global vaccine portfolio; also developing vaccines for dengue and other diseases. |

### How to Learn More
- **Company Websites:** Most manufacturers maintain detailed sections on their vaccine pipelines and research initiatives.
- **WHO Vaccine Portfolio:** Offers a comprehensive list of licensed and investigational vaccines globally.
- **ClinicalTrials.gov:** Provides up-to-date information on ongoing vaccine trials.

If you need deeper details on a specific manufacturer, such as their production capacity, regulatory approvals, or upcoming vaccine candidates, let me know!
